_doc: SPOILER. A soft talk (people spec §11, §21.3; build item N-7.6.7): no lamps, it never fails. Rules in scripts/game/confront.gd.
title: Cass, about her drawings

statements.text: I draw everything. Tents, boards, people. Silas says it's a waste of charcoal.
statements.press: If I draw it, I've got it. That's how it works. That's how it's always worked.

statements.text: I'm better than I was last year. I'm sure I am.
statements.press: It's only that the lines don't stay where I put them, lately.

statements.text: It's the cold. My hands go stupid in the cold.
statements.press: It's spring, I know. I know it's spring.

evidence.name: Her drawing of you on the wagon board

breaks.text: Cass: (She looks at the board for a long moment.) I did that. I did do that, didn't I? (She laughs, too loudly.) Course I did.

won: Cass picks up her charcoal again, and holds it a little tighter.

closes.text: Tell her you'll sit for her
